Grandpa moves to Australia on Sunday. Jay has seven days. He's never once heard him laugh.
Why did the scarecrow win an award?
Because he was outstanding in his field. Nineteen fifty-two.
Tuesday, the whoopee cushion. Grandpa sits on it, and simply waits for it to finish.
On Saturday, Jay gives up and opens the old photo album.
That was nineteen seventy-four. I thought I looked like a rock star.
And then Grandpa laughs. A huge, wheezing, slapping-his-knee laugh.
Send me photos. Especially of your haircuts.
